alternative_hypothesis: At least one preregistered finite-core topology kernel is numerically converged and reproducible across the E013-frozen independent provider anchors, while stationarity-qualified local spectra supply additional target-free state information without target-specific fitting.
assumptions: E013 is the carrier-selection authority for this version. Every scientific carrier must appear in the exact SST_CROSS_CARRIER_MANIFEST supplied by the E013 campaign.
E011-v0.3.0 STATIC_READY provider anchors are geometry/provenance-qualified static seeds, not DYNAMICS_READY states; A057 must independently test its dynamic assumptions.
E010-v0.3.1 is used only to reload the exact source-native geometry bytes and optional topology-reference metadata for E013-selected carriers; it is not used to discover replacement carriers.
Legacy A057 or other falsifier outputs, verdicts, spectra, energies, relaxed states, provider means, and mass fits are forbidden as scientific evidence.
The operational energy kernel is a Rosenhead-regularized slender-filament Hamiltonian and remains a reduced finite-core approximation to the three-dimensional kinetic-energy integral.
Reach normalization sets the dimensionless comparison scale; SI restoration uses r_c only after the target-free dimensionless kernel is frozen.

Reduced variational dynamics use topology-preserving small Bishop-frame perturbations. A carrier is a stability candidate only if its normalized energy gradient satisfies the preregistered v0.2.0 stationarity threshold for the active profile.
Protected observed masses, identity mappings, and historical numerical comparison targets are inaccessible to BLIND code and outputs.
Scientific FAIL does not suppress later diagnostic gates; protocol, implementation, common-carrier binding, and hash integrity remain fail-closed.
edge_cases: BASIC supplies one provider anchor per topology, so cross-provider variance gates can be UNRESOLVED by design rather than spuriously FAIL.
A topology with one STATIC_READY provider can produce carrier diagnostics but cannot close cross-provider replication.
A nonstationary carrier may still yield a Hessian/Jacobian diagnostic, but its spectrum is labeled DIAGNOSTIC_NONSTATIONARY and is excluded from stability-ratio certification.
Near-zero or negative Hessian eigenvalues may leave frequency ratios undefined; these cases remain explicit.
Multicomponent links with signed mutual energy can yield indefinite coherence matrices; signed eigenvalues and absolute-energy participation remain reported.
An optional topology absent from E013 is not replaced by a legacy or convenient geometry.

falsification_criteria.criterion: No energy kernel attains carrier-level numerical convergence at the preregistered tolerance in any independently sourced topology with at least two admissible groups.
Within-topology variation of the converged energy kernel is not smaller than between-topology variation under the registered variance-ratio discriminator.
C++ FP64 differs from Python FP64 by relative L2 above 1e-10 for the certification kernel.
Registered geometry-plus-spectrum surrogates fail to improve protected topology-holdout energy prediction over the simplest geometry baseline by the preregistered improvement threshold.
A protected post-reveal target comparison may not be promoted if its blind prediction was not present in PREDICTIONS_FROZEN.json produced by the prior FULL/CERTIFY run.

implementation_commitment.rule: Mismatch is a protocol/infrastructure failure. The E013 common-carrier contract and all science implementation bytes are committed; scientific FAIL gates continue diagnostically.

null_hypothesis: On the common current-PKLSA carrier population, no registered energy/dynamical functional is both numerically converged and reproducible across independent E011 provider anchors, or any apparent spectral structure is confined to nonstationary diagnostic states.
objective: Re-run the A057 geometry/energy/Lagrangian/Hamiltonian/Hessian/Jacobian program from source bytes for exactly the carriers frozen by E013. predictions: If a topology-sensitive finite-core kernel is real, FULL/CERTIFY should show smaller within-topology provider spread than between-topology spread on the exact E013 common carriers.

If local modal ratios are physical stability observables rather than coordinate diagnostics, repeated provider anchors must first satisfy the registered stationarity threshold and then reproduce the ratios within topology.
If mass information is predominantly structural, simple geometry/topology surrogates should remain competitive with or outperform added spectral complexity on target-free energy holdouts.
research_question: On one E013-frozen common population of current E011 STATIC_READY provider anchors, does the finite-core Hamiltonian and its local variational diagnostics yield reproducible, topology-sensitive target-free kernels suitable for a Master-Mass reconstruction, without reusing any scientific result from legacy falsifier runs?

steps.operation: Verify the E013 common carrier manifest, bind to E011 STATIC_READY provider anchors, reload only those exact source bytes through E010 parsers, and recheck raw/geometry hashes.
Run analytic/synthetic controls, SI scale checks, orientation/rigid-motion/resampling controls.

Evaluate held-out independent carrier groups without pooling distinct carriers as numerical refinement levels.
Compare C++/pybind11 FP64 regularized energy matrix with Python/NumPy FP64 reference.
Record framework SYCL/DD32 screening evidence separately from certification authority.
Quantify replication across E013-frozen provider groups; never replace missing providers with legacy carriers.
Compute self/mutual energy matrices, coherence spectra, and an independent Bishop-frame core-tube kinetic-energy quadrature for a bounded topology subset.
Measure normalized energy-gradient stationarity on each common carrier using the profile-frozen v0.2.0 threshold; nonstationary states remain diagnostic only.
Evaluate Legendre-transform closure and reduced Hamiltonian conservation.
Construct finite-difference Hessians on the same common carriers and promote stability interpretation only for stationarity-qualified states.
Construct Jacobians, extract spectra, and compare oscillatory frequencies with direct reduced integration.
Certify target-free spectral ratios only across repeated stationarity-qualified provider anchors of the same topology.
Cross-validate simple geometry surrogates against the finite-core energy kernel with topology-grouped holdouts.
Compare preregistered energy-only and geometry-plus-spectrum surrogate families under a complexity penalty.
Freeze a complete target-free topology prediction table and anonymous composite predictions before reveal.
Evaluate protected topology holdout generalization internal to the geometry/energy task; no observed mass targets are used.
Restore SI scales using canonical SST constants in two density lanes and write target-free absolute predictions.
Stress core regularization, discretization, carrier selection, and perturbation amplitude; quantify sensitivity.
Jackknife across provider/lineage groups and report whether findings replicate in independent evidence families.
Assign a blind multi-level classification from all recorded evidence while preserving diagnostic results from failed upstream scientific gates.
